user_en: A patient prescribed doxycycline (or ciprofloxacin) takes it at the same time as their calcium carbonate antacid and iron tablets, and the infection isn't improving. Why might that be?

runs.answer:
DECISION: PHARMACIST-LED  
SEVERITY: 4  
RED FLAGS: none identified  
CONDITION: Inadequate antibiotic absorption due to concurrent antacid/mineral intake  
ICD-10: J95.8 (Other specified infectious disease)  
ROUTING: Pharmacist-led advice on dose separation and adherence monitoring  
SAFETY-NET: Monitor for symptom resolution within 48–72 hours; seek urgent care if fever >38.5°C, hypotension, or worsening signs develop

DECISION: PHARMACIST-LED
SEVERITY: 3
RED FLAGS: none identified
CONDITION: Reduced antibiotic absorption due to concurrent intake of calcium/iron supplements
ICD-10: Z51.2
ROUTING: Pharmacist-led education on medication timing
SAFETY-NET: Separate doxycycline/ciprofloxacin from antacids/iron by 2 hours; monitor for symptom resolution within 48–72 hours; seek urgent care if fever/worsening signs develop
